scope: trusted isolated evaluation database only; existing tenant and original durable run
prerequisites: PM authorization and account region/plan/API host/model permissions/egress facts
exact fixed snapshot price mapping approved
provider contract proves all billed output <=512 including max_tokens error

trustedSetup.workers: stopped and collected before setup; no active leases or dispatches on queued selected tasks
trustedSetup.transaction: lock exact tenant_budget, original evaluation_budget and two tenant-scoped queued task rows FOR UPDATE; abort on identity/profile/state mismatch
trustedSetup.changes: only tenant_budget.token_limit and selected task.max_tokens; matrix request ceiling may only tighten original remaining authorization
trustedSetup.preserve: all spent/held including UNKNOWN, run identity/state, task snapshots, output512, currency1CNY; never clear or reopen STOPPED
trustedSetup.allowance: existing token holds plus worst remaining dispatches must fit quota; original monetary/request remaining allowance must cover matrix; otherwise refuse or reduce plan
trustedSetup.isolation: dedicated private tenant; no API/model quota parameters, shared DB changes or production loading
trustedSetup.cleanup: export rows and receipts; collect owned processes; remove private evaluation environment; never delete accounting to regain allowance
